female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

ag-input-specificity-faster.title: Pitches that list specific quantities or types of agricultural inputs predict faster funding regardless of gender.
ag-input-specificity-faster.body: The inclusion of precise details regarding agricultural inputs, such as specific counts of livestock or seed types, accelerates funding for both men and women.

male-repayment-promise-faster.body: Male borrowers who explicitly promise to repay the loan promptly may fund faster.

male-local-currency-slower.body: Male borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-explicit-age-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age in the pitch text may fund more slowly.

female-financial-barrier-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention limited financial resources as a barrier may fund more slowly.

female-family-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed descriptions of family size and children's education may fund more slowly.

female-widow-children-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention being a widow with children may fund more slowly.

female-environment-savings-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention saving money in conjunction with helping the environment may fund more slowly.

female-photo-id-faster.body: Female borrowers who include a note identifying the person in the photo may fund faster.

female-spouse-income-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention using a spouse's income for loan repayment may fund faster.

female-business-duration-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the number of years their business has been operating may fund faster.

female-family-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific family details like children or a partner's occupation may fund faster.
female-family-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed family descriptions predict slower funding for women

female-technical-use-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe specific technical uses of loan funds may fund more slowly.
female-technical-use-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-product-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify exact products being purchased for resale fund faster.
female-product-specificity-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for a general claim supported by cross-gender evidence.

business-duration-slower-general.title: Pitches that specify the number of years the borrower has been in business tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.
business-duration-slower-general.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted claim.

male-crop-specificity-faster.title: Male borrowers who list multiple specific crop types may fund faster.

female-essential-farm-inputs-slower.title: Female borrowers who use the phrase 'essential farm inputs' may fund more slowly.
female-essential-farm-inputs-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-health-hazard-risks-faster.title: Female borrowers who use the specific phrase 'health and hazard risks' may fund faster.
female-health-hazard-risks-faster.retrospective: Retired as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.title: Pitches from women that explicitly use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' are associated with increased funding speed.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for a higher-evidence general claim.

female-business-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about business duration or crop variety may fund more slowly.
